request: Inspect only Receiver mount destinations, security policies and network identities for safe image promotion

bounded_host_request.command:
python3 -c 'import subprocess,json
a,b=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(["docker","inspect","server-core-bounded-host","server-core-bounded-host-stage-96d01bb"]))
for z in (a,b):
 h=z["HostConfig"];n=z["NetworkSettings"]["Networks"]["gace-internal"]
 print("MOUNT_CONTRACT",sorted((v["Destination"],v["RW"]) for v in z["Mounts"]))
 print("SECURITY",h.get("SecurityOpt"),"RESTART",h["RestartPolicy"]["Name"],"IP",n["IPAddress"])
 print("NETWORKS",sorted(z["NetworkSettings"]["Networks"]))'
